definition: יָחִיל adjective verb. waiting , so Thes SS Buhl , but very dubious, — only טוֺב וְיָחִיל וְדוּמָם לְ Lam 3:26 good is it that one be waiting and that silently (but see דוּמָם ) for the salvation of ׳ י ; construct. with ו and adjective hardly possibly; Ew Ke Lohr Kö ii. 407 and others regard as verb (from חול ); read perhaps וְיֹחִיל Hiph`il Imperfect from יחל (compare v Lam 3:24 ).
